note: EXPERIMENTAL Detection Panel families and the Ross Panel's per-row pullback cue (owner decision 2026-10-21). detection-v1 with one change: the micro-pullback runs as variant MP5 of the pre-registered setup comparison (branch research/setup-compare, docs/research/setup-compare/frozen-choice.json): impulse_min_bp 500, max_depth_milli 382, impulse_min_coverage_milli 750, every other number as in detection-v1. It is the ONE pullback detector: the Ross Panel's cue reads these episodes and replaces bull_flag_v0 there. ross.outcome_hold_secs only decides how long a trigger_observed or invalidated episode stays on a Ross row; it never changes an event, a state or an order. On the 2026-10-07..20 holdout MP5's +3%-before-1.5% precision was 0.183 against bull_flag_v0 BF1's 0.163, confidence intervals overlapping: a trigger_observed episode failed about 3 times in 4. A cue describes a stage, it is not a validated entry signal. No edge, probability or performance claim. A changed number is a new file and id. See docs/stock-context/detection-core.md and docs/stock-context/ross-panel-v1.md.
